notes.title: GoNNER BLüEBERRY Edition Hotfix Patch Live!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12155155/9afc55e0c0529544c9d37e7c6a2cde6113d6e111.gif

Dear blüeberry hoppers,

We've just launched a tiny hotfix patch to fix a number of pesky issues that accompanied the release of BLüEBERRY Edition.

Patch Notes
 - Fixed a launch issue on Linux
 - Fixed an issue where the App file would not always be correctly found on MacOS
 - Fixed an issue where MacOS builds could become corrupted on download

Good luck, and don't lose your head :gonskull::gonheart:

notes.title: Update coming!
notes.notes:
Hello hey, heey!

I'm just here to say that I'm working on a pretty major update to the game. There's quite a few changes, fixes and balancing to the current game. There's fixes for keyboard controls. There's Performance fixes. There's even more visual crazy for high combos. There's even more secrets! Most notably though, there's Daily Runs! WOAH! 

"WHEN IS IT COMING OUT???"
[spoiler] SOON! <3 [/spoiler]

//
Ditto

ps. For future updates, is it interesting to see me write out everything that's changed? Do you want that? Isn't it more interesting to go in blind and discover what's new? Am I just lazy? Tell me what you think in the comments <3

notes.title: Lose Your Head In Gonner With October Release
notes.notes:
Gonner [official site] – a side-scrolly playform shooter – took Adam’s fancy at GDC. I don’t say that lightly either. He proclaimed it “the best pure action game I saw at the show”. In case it had tickled your fancy too, it now has a release date of 12 October
